features:
automatically teleports you to each egg every 2 seconds. you can get alot of admin tokens per 30 minutes ( most i got was 1000 )
you will need to spam the e button in order to claim each egg.

-- scripts open source cus i dont really care... its gonna get patched on saturday anyway

----
PLEASE READ**
----
Sometimes ( especially when trying to claim the 9th egg, you may get teleported somewhere else or teleported back to the previous egg, if that happens, just rexecute the egg till you claim all 10 )

YOU WILL NEED TO CLAIM EVERY EGG BY THE SCAVENTURE UI BEFORE REJOINING, OR YOU WONT GET ANYTHING.

comments.text: I recommend having atleast 3 shields when doing this. you can run into alot of waves
